cards.text: Friend, the LORD has just said that Cyrus, king of Persia (Ezra 1:1), will set His exiles free (Isaiah 45:13). Now the LORD keeps speaking through the prophet Isaiah, to someone He calls "you." He says the products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, the land past Egypt's southern border (Ezekiel 29:10), along with the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to "you" and be yours.

cards.question: The LORD says these nations will trudge behind "you" and come over in chains. Then what will they do?
The LORD says the nations who come over will confess that their own gods are with them.

cards.text: Their confession goes: "God is indeed with you, and there is no other; there is no other God." Then comes a line spoken straight to God: "Truly You are a God who hides Himself, O God of Israel, the Savior." Hidden, and still the Savior, friend.

cards.question: Next comes a word about the people who make idols. How does it say the makers of idols will depart?
The idol makers will depart in disgrace. But the LORD will save Israel with an everlasting salvation, and Israel will not be put to ___ or humiliated.

cards.text: Then come words from the LORD, who created the heavens and formed the earth, and did not create it to be empty. An empty cookie box sitting on my counter? I take that PERSONALLY, friend.

cards.question: The LORD didn't create the earth to be empty. So what did He form it for?

cards.text: The LORD says He hasn't spoken in secret, from a place in a land of darkness, and He never told Jacob's descendants to seek Him in a wasteland. Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer, and NOBODY in that kitchen ever heard a word I said.

cards.question: The LORD says that He speaks the truth and says what is right.

cards.text: Now the LORD calls out: "Come, gather together, and draw near, you fugitives from the nations." Not keep away, friend. Draw NEAR.

cards.question: The LORD calls some people ignorant. Who are they?

answers.text: Those who carry idols of wood

cards.text: They carry the idol around, then pray to a god that cannot save. That's like me lugging a cookie box across the bakery and then asking the BOX to carry ME.

cards.question: The LORD says "Speak up and present your case…" and then asks who foretold this long ago. What's His answer?

answers.text: It was the wise of Egypt

cards.question: In that same speech, the LORD calls Himself a righteous God and Savior.

cards.text: Then the LORD gives an invitation, and He says why: "for I am God, and there is no other." Lean in, friend, this is the big one.

cards.question: The LORD says "Turn to Me and be saved…" How far does that invitation reach?

answers.text: To all the ends of the earth

cards.text: Then the LORD swears by Himself. Truth has gone out from His mouth, a word that will not be revoked.

cards.question: The LORD swears that only the descendants of Jacob will bow before Him.
Every knee will bow before the LORD, and every tongue will swear allegiance. What will they surely say of Him?

answers.text: Righteousness and strength are in Him alone
He is one god among many others
Their idols can still save them too

cards.question: Everyone who rages against the LORD will stay far away from Him.
Those who rage against the LORD will be put to shame. But in the LORD, all descendants of Israel will be justified and will ___.
